body: This 2025 Sprinter AWD 144 build in our El Capitan Tier is built for compact off-grid comfort with serious adventure capability. With a pop top, lifting bed, dinette seating, indoor shower, high-capacity lithium power, diesel heat, undermount A/C, and Starlink Mini, it’s designed to stay comfortable while traveling farther.

Inside, the van has a warm wood finish with stained ceiling and walls, dimmable lighting, luxury vinyl flooring, smart storage, dinette seating, and a foldaway passenger seat setup designed for everyday comfort and life on the road.
